recipes.name: Incredible Punch
ingredients_raw: 1 (32 fluid ounce) bottle pina colada mix

steps.text: In a large plastic container, combine cranberry-raspberry juice with the pina colada mix. Freeze overnight.
Remove from freezer 30 minutes prior to serving. To serve place frozen slush in punch bowl and slowly add raspberry ginger ale.

raw_recipe.headline: Incredible Punch
raw_recipe.description: Absolutely the best punch! A hit at showers, teas and kids' birthday parties. It's made with cran-raspberry juice, ginger ale and pina colada mixer and has a beautiful pink color!.

review.reviewBody: Very well received punch I made for a Baby Shower! I froze two zip lock bags with mix the night before as suggested by another reviewer. Froze bags on side so blocks were long, wide and thinner as opposed to a thick block. Took mix out 2 hours before shower and it turned into a perfect slush/sludge. Added 3 liters (not 2) of Gigerale and Rasberry Soda and mixed to right consistency. Couldn't find Rasberry Gingerale, but Walmarts had Gingerale and Rasberry soda (mixed about 1/4-1/3 Rasberry to Gingerale). I made a Cranberry-Rasberry ice ring. Colors were beautiful, mix was delicous! Thanks for this recipe.

This punch is delicious! I used two 2ltr bottles of ginger ale and one 2ltr bottle of strawberry soda since I couldn’t find raspberry soda at all. I made a frozen ring using fresh raspberries that I froze and put in the bottom of the mold. I scooped softened (it should be like a thick liquid) raspberry sherbet over the raspberries and froze it. Then I poured the cold juice and coconut mix over to fill. It kept the punch cold and really dressed it up. You definitely want to remove your slush from the freezer 1 to 1-1/2 hours before adding to the soda.
I made with pina colada Daily mix from GFS, and Ocean Spray Cran-Pomegranate. Used 7 Up. Added rum. Made ice ring with limes and strawberries. Big hit. Poured some out before rum for na drinkers.

I made this for my daughter-in-law's baby shower last year and kept a bottle of raspberry vodka on the side.Put large plastic ziplock bags into empty coffee containers and then pour in punch. It's easy to freeze and transport that way. Making it again for Baby Miranda's 1 st birthday. Everyone loved it.

The stores around me did not have the raspberry Ginger ale either, so I use the regular Ginger ale and I added a pint of raspberry sorbet. The girls at the office raved about it and absolutely loved it.

Thanks for this recipe, it sounds amazing and I plan to make it for my sisters baby shower. Quick question, the pina colada mix contains alcohol, right? Can I substitute the mix for Bacardi Mixers pina colada non-alcoholic frozen concentrate? Please let me know!!! The shower is next week.

This was awesome! I made it for my daughter's 10th birthday party and everyone loved it. I only used 1 bottle of Pina colada mix with one bottle of cran-raspberry juice and had to use 3 liters of raspberry ginger ale (which I could only find at our local neighborhood mkt). I split the mix into two 1 gallon bags to freeze the night before. I took them out two hours prior to thaw. I think 2 1/2 would have been better. But it turned out great! I'm making it again for thanksgiving dinner this week!

I made this punch for a social function and now I'm not allowed to bring anything else but this! I couldn't find flavored ginger ale so I used regular and it turned out okay. I also used 2 cans of frozen pina colada mix, and I used the tip about placing the frozen mixture in ziploc bags. It makes it much easier to transport when you have to take it to someone's home. Thanks again for posting this!
Excellent! used cranberry ginger ale- froze in 2 large ziploc bags (still mostly solid even though i took them out 90 minutes prior- would do 2 hours next time)- beautiful and tasty punch!

Made this with a cosmopolitan mix instead of pina colada - and it was great! Had to make 2 batches for a baby shower and both disappeared before the party was over. It's definitely a sweet drink, but the pink color looked pretty in the punch bowl. We made a fancy ice ring with some sliced up limes and raspberries to accent it as well. Very easy and cheap to put together for a crowd.

I personally don't like raspberry anything, but I made this for a baby shower because it could be made ahead of time, didn't require extra ice or a ring, and was pink in keeping of the shower's theme. It was a HUGE hit. So much a hit that I was requested to make the same punch for the christening reception. I made double the recipe and had almost nothing left over with nearly 30 people there at each event. Two quibbles - I can't find raspberry ginger ale anywhere nor was it on any grocery's available list. I used raspberry seltzer and it worked fine. Also, the frozen punch base needs to come out of the freezer much earlier than 30 minutes. The second time I took it out an hour early and it still had to be broken up.
This is such an easy, pretty, and delicious punch recipe!!! My go to!! I freeze it in ziplock bags.
Made this for my 12 yr old granddaughters New Years Eve party with her friends last year. They all loved it and she requested it again for this years party. Easy recipe and impressive presentation.
Fabulous ! It was such a big hit at my daughter's baby shower and I had to make a second batch ! I was happy I had frozen a second ice block of the pina colada mix and rasp/cranberry juice !
I had to use a different flavor of ginger ale but it still worked. I made this for a reception and everyone raved about it!
Super delicious and easy to make. It's yummy as-is, but I think it's even better spiked with Malibu Rum. I also couldn't find Raspberry ginger ale so I've used Cherry 7up and Cranberry Sierra Mist.
This punch was so easy to make and was to die for! Many great compliments!
I can't find the cranberry ginger ale but have made this twice using the regular kind. Very good.

I made this for my Mom's 90th birthday party. I made it to the exact recipe except that I added pomegranate seeds to the mixture as it was freezing, and they added a nice little touch. The guests all gave it high reviews and I was asked over and over for the recipe. The punch was still delicious when I had to start "watering" it down with more ginger ale & then lemon-lime drink to make it go further! 
 I found the raspberry ginger ale at Walmart in a 12 pack of cans, and just added 6 cans to each tub of slush. It did take at least 1 1/2 hours to get the frozen mixture slushy.
